weekLabel: Week of Aug 31 to Sep 6 · refreshed Sunday Aug 30. Labor Day weekend. Tap a source to confirm before you go.

events.when: Thu Sep 3 - Sun Sep 6 (fireworks Sat evening, Parade of Sail Sun 10am)
events.name: Gloucester Schooner Festival (42nd annual)
events.meta: Free from shore · Gloucester Harbor, Gloucester · Tall ships fill the harbor for the best maritime weekend on the North Shore. Fireworks over the water Saturday evening (fireworks sails leave around 8:00-8:15pm, so confirm the exact show time in the program). Parade of Sail Sunday 10am, Mayor's Cup Races Sunday 1pm. Stacy Boulevard for the parade, Stage Fort Park for the fireworks. Big crowds and tight parking, so get to Stage Fort early with chairs. source

events.name: Somerville Nepali Street Food Festival
events.meta: Free · Somerville City Hall, 93 Highland Ave, Somerville · Eleven Nepali food vendors, live cultural music and dance, and a DJ in from Nepal. Closest thing on the list and the easiest yes of the weekend: park once, eat everything. source

events.name: Open Newbury Street
events.meta: Free · Newbury St, Berkeley to Mass Ave, Back Bay, Boston · Newbury goes car-free and pedestrian-only for the day. Cafes spill into the street, easy walking, good morning coffee-and-pastry stop first. Take the T; Back Bay parking on a car-free Sunday is a losing game. source

events.name: Tom Rush at Prescott Park Arts Festival
events.meta: Suggested donation around $20, nobody turned away (verify) · Prescott Park, 105 Marcy St, Portsmouth NH · Waterfront outdoor show on the lawn. Blankets and chairs, harbor right there, walkable Portsmouth for dinner after. Confirm set time and whether lawn tables need reserving. source

events.when: Sat Sep 5 - Mon Sep 7, daytime (verify 2026 hours)
events.name: Newburyport Labor Day Festival
events.meta: Free performances · Downtown Newburyport and the waterfront · Three days of free band concerts, buskers, magicians, jugglers, craft vendors and a dog parade. Several listings still carry old years, so verify the 2026 dates and daily times on the city calendar before driving up. source

events.when: Labor Day weekend, beach open early; Great House tours on the hour
events.name: Crane Beach and Castle Hill, Ipswich
events.meta: Beach parking fee; Great House tours ticketed (price verify) · 290 Argilla Rd, Ipswich · Last real beach weekend of the season. The Great House at Castle Hill is open for holiday tours, plus a sunset hike out toward Steep Hill Beach and Cedar Point. Crane fills by mid-morning on a holiday weekend, so be in the lot before 9. source

events.name: College football is back: BC opens at Cincinnati
events.meta: Free at home, or the price of lunch out · On TV; Coastal Mass Brewing, 100 Cummings Center, Beverly if you want a room for it · No pro home game locally this week, so this is the Dave-and-Alex play: BC's season opener on the road, watched somewhere with food and a big screen. Coastal Mass in Beverly is open Sat 12-10pm and is the family-friendly version. Confirm kickoff time and network. source

events.name: Boston College vs Rutgers (Red Bandanna Game)
events.meta: Ticketed · Alumni Stadium, 2599 Beacon St, Chestnut Hill · BC's home opener on the 25th anniversary of 9/11, honoring Welles Crowther. Night game, real atmosphere, and the best value college football ticket near Boston. Single-game seats are on sale now and this one will move. source

events.when: Fri Sep 11 6-11pm, Sat Sep 12 1-11pm, Sun Sep 13 1-10pm
events.name: 101st Feast of Saints Cosmas and Damian
events.meta: Free · 17 Porter St, East Cambridge · Candlelight procession and fireworks Friday, Taylor Dayne headlining Saturday, and the Grand Procession Sunday at 1:30pm through East Cambridge and Somerville. Carnival rides, games, Italian food. source

events.name: 32nd Cambridge Carnival International
events.meta: Free · University Park Commons, Cambridge · Around 100,000 people, costumes, steel pan, soca, dance and food and craft vendors. One of the best free days of the year for KK and Isabella. Red Line to Central, do not drive. source

events.name: Revolution vs Orlando City
events.meta: Ticketed, parking free · Gillette Stadium, 1 Patriot Place, Foxborough · The only Revs home match in September. Cheaper and easier than the NFL, and Patriot Place handles dinner before kickoff. source

events.name: Patriots home opener vs Steelers
events.meta: Ticketed · Gillette Stadium, 1 Patriot Place, Foxborough · First home game of the season. If this is the year to take Alex to a Patriots game, buy soon; Week 2 home openers do not get cheaper. source
